nodes.rationale: Coverage grouped by specialty distinguishes discovery or ranking failures from extraction failures spread across visited pages.

nodes.label: Institution Validation
nodes.rationale: K-12 institutions are rejected before extraction compute is spent, using hostname and homepage evidence before consulting a model.

nodes.label: Two-Tier Skip Check
nodes.rationale: Known-page content hashes provide a cheap first check, while address-set Jaccard similarity supplies a second check when content changed.

nodes.label: Cross-Host Roster Discovery
nodes.rationale: Departmental rosters often live on sibling hosts, so discovery walks sitemaps for in-scope hosts revealed by the site and filters unrelated sibling hosts by label.

nodes.label: Candidate Page Ranking
nodes.rationale: Ranking emphasizes the URL leaf and token sets, vetoes news-like sections, and prioritizes current rosters while retaining lower-ranked faculty and alumni listings.

nodes.label: Dynamic Extraction Frontier
nodes.rationale: Links discovered during extraction are scored into only the unvisited tail so newly found rosters can move forward without invalidating the loop cursor or refetching pages.

nodes.label: Cost-Escalating Extraction
nodes.rationale: Plain HTML is always attempted first; browser rendering, screenshots, interaction, and vision are used only when page evidence shows cheaper parsing is insufficient.

nodes.label: Barren-Page Early Stop
nodes.rationale: A consecutive barren stretch in a ranked candidate list indicates productive pages are likely exhausted; the counter tracks people found so unchanged re-scrapes do not stop prematurely.

nodes.label: Accessibility-Tree Browser Interaction
nodes.rationale: Browser actions identify elements by accessibility role and name instead of predicted screenshot coordinates; vision reads content and disambiguates links but does not produce click targets.

nodes.label: Record Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Per-site PostgreSQL advisory locks prevent interleaved writes, records remain immutable through versions, and a person is marked missing only after the source page was successfully revisited.

nodes.label: Latest-Run Screenshot Retention
nodes.rationale: Only the most recent run's images are retained to bound local storage, while textual provenance and field locations survive supersession.

nodes.label: site_runs Work Queue
nodes.rationale: A PostgreSQL row-backed queue with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED provides atomic claims, restart survival, and no separate broker within the single-box architecture.

nodes.label: Checkpointed Mid-Site Resume
nodes.rationale: Persisting the ranked list and cursor after each batch lets interrupted runs resume extraction without repeating discovery, while per-batch reconciliation preserves collected results.

nodes.label: Resource and Spend Limits
nodes.rationale: Concurrency is rejected when it exceeds available memory, and live record and spend counters stop new claims while allowing in-flight work to drain into valid partial results.
